parsed.name: RPLIDAR激光雷达
parsed.description: 用于机器人环境感知的二维激光雷达。该设备通过连续扫描获取距离与角度测量数据，可用于避障、定位、建图和周围环境轮廓检测。
parsed.description_en: A 2D LiDAR sensor for robot environment perception. It continuously scans to acquire distance and angle measurements, enabling obstacle avoidance, localization, mapping, and surrounding scene detection.

actions.description: 更新并读取最新的激光雷达扫描测量数据。
actions.description_en: Update and read the latest LiDAR scan measurements.

actions.description: 在线程模式下返回当前缓存的激光雷达扫描数据。
actions.description_en: Return the currently cached LiDAR scan data in threaded mode.

actions.description: 停止激光雷达采集并关闭设备连接。
actions.description_en: Stop LiDAR acquisition and close the device connection.
